title: Derived supported Kummer lines and their normalized compact images
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $F/\mathbf Q_\ell$ and $n\geq0$, and put $A=\mathcal O_F/\varpi_F^{n+1}$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. On the ordinary constant-$A$ module derived categories of schemes [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories, def-weil-pbc-proetale-modules], let $N=\ell^{n+1}$ and retain a proof $h_A:NA=0$. Write $L_T=\mu^{\mathrm{et}}_{N,T}\otimes_{\mathbf Z/N}A$ for the existing etale line [def-asd-finite-etale-tate-twist], and $P_T=A_T(1)$ for the prescribed pro-etale line in fixed-scalar coordinates [def-pur-finite-tate-site-comparison]. Define $\mathsf L_T=L_T[0]$ and $\mathsf P_T=P_T[0]$ in $D^+$. For an effective Cartier divisor $i:D\hookrightarrow T$, given invertibility of $\ell$ on $T$, use the etale and pro-etale members of the uniquely normalized Kummer family of [lem-amb-cartier-kummer-map]. Define $c_i^{\mathrm{et}}:\mathbf P_{i,\mathrm{et}}	o\mathsf L_T[2]$ and $c_i^{\mathrm{proet}}:\mathbf P_{i,\mathrm{proet}}	o\mathsf P_T[2]$ by their degree-two Ext realization in $D^+$, with supported sources as in [def-pur-section-compact-source-maps]. For this realization use the canonical inclusion comparison $\iota(M[0][2])\cong M[0][2]$, formed from the shift comparison and the degree-zero inclusion comparison, and then the unique preimage of the Ext morphism under the fully faithful $D^+	o D$ inclusion. The same inclusion and Ext-realization constructions are defined for every abelian category with the relevant derived category and Ext groups.

For any specified isomorphism $q:
u_T^*L_T\cong P_T$, define its shifted derived comparison $\alpha_T:
u_T^*(\mathsf L_T[2])\cong\mathsf P_T[2]$ by composing the exact comparison-pullback shift isomorphism, the degree-zero comparison and the degree-zero image of $q$ [def-sf-comparison-derived-pullback]. Now let $\pi:X	o B$ have a compactification $c$ [def-weil-compactifications-refinements] and a closed section $z$ with $\pi\circ z=1_B$, whose image is Cartier, with $\ell$ invertible on $X$. Use $F_t^c=R\pi_{!,t}^c$ [def-amb-etale-compact-support, def-compact-support-direct-image-detailed] and the normalized sources $a_c^t$ of [def-pur-section-compact-source-maps]. Define the actual compact Kummer images by $	au_c^{\mathrm{et}}=F_{\mathrm{et}}^c(c_z^{\mathrm{et}})\circ a_c^{\mathrm{et}}$ and $	au_c^{\mathrm{proet}}=F_{\mathrm{proet}}^c(c_z^{\mathrm{proet}})\circ a_c^{\mathrm{proet}}$. Finally define the compact target comparison $F_{\mathrm{proet}}^c(\mathsf P_X[2])\xrightarrow{\sim}
u_B^*F_{\mathrm{et}}^c(\mathsf L_X[2])$ as $F_{\mathrm{proet}}^c(\alpha_X^{-1})$ followed by the inverse of the specified compact-support site comparison at $\mathsf L_X[2]$ [def-sf-compact-support-site-comparison-construction]. These are the specified objects and actual composites; no equality of class maps under base change or between the two sites is asserted by this definition, and no supported cohomology is identified with compact cohomology.
